```{r}
# =========================================================
# FINAL SECTION — CLEAN TREATMENT DETECTION, SUMMARIZE & PLOT
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

WORK_DIR <- "C:/Users/Supriya Monajigari/Documents"
OUT_DIR  <- file.path(WORK_DIR, "gps_density_final_plots")
if (!dir.exists(OUT_DIR)) dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)

# 🟢 Combine all extracted density tables
all_dens <- bind_rows(dens_true, dens_plus, dens_minus)

# 🟢 Detect treatment strictly by final letter before .gpkg (or _true, etc.)
all_dens <- all_dens %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = case_when(
      grepl("D(_|\\.|$)", toupper(Plot)) ~ "Deferred",
      grepl("C(_|\\.|$)", toupper(Plot)) ~ "Continuous",
      grepl("E(_|\\.|$)", toupper(Plot)) ~ "Exclosed",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    Phase = case_when(
      grepl("1", Phase) ~ "Phase1",
      grepl("2", Phase) ~ "Phase2",
      TRUE ~ Phase
    )
  )

# 🧭 Verify detection
print(table(all_dens$Treatment))

# 🟢 Summarize mean ± SE per Treatment × Variant × Phase
summary_density <- all_dens %>%
  filter(Treatment %in% c("Deferred", "Continuous", "Exclosed")) %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Variant, Phase) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_density = mean(Density_pts_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_density   = sd(Density_pts_ha, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 🟢 Fill missing combinations
summary_density <- expand_grid(
  Treatment = c("Deferred", "Continuous", "Exclosed"),
  Variant   = unique(summary_density$Variant),
  Phase     = unique(summary_density$Phase)
) %>%
  left_join(summary_density, by = c("Treatment", "Variant", "Phase")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(mean_density, se_density), ~replace_na(.x, 0)))

# 🟢 Consistent ordering
summary_density$Treatment <- factor(summary_density$Treatment,
  levels = c("Deferred", "Continuous", "Exclosed"))
summary_density$Variant <- factor(summary_density$Variant,
  levels = c("True", "Liberal (+5 m)", "Conservative (−5 m)"))

# 🟢 Plotting function
make_plot <- function(df, phase_label, title_text) {
  ggplot(filter(df, Phase == phase_label),
         aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_density, fill = Variant)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_density - se_density,
                      ymax = mean_density + se_density),
                  width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
    labs(title = title_text,
         x = "Treatment Type",
         y = "Mean GPS Point Density (points / ha)") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "True" = "#1b9e77",
      "Liberal (+5 m)" = "#d95f02",
      "Conservative (−5 m)" = "#7570b3"
    )) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "top")
}

# 🟢 Create and save both phase plots
p1 <- make_plot(summary_density, "Phase1", "Mean GPS Point Density (Jul 1 – Aug 3)")
p2 <- make_plot(summary_density, "Phase2", "Mean GPS Point Density (Aug 4 – Sep 3)")

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "phase1_density_final.png"), p1, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "phase2_density_final.png"), p2, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

message("\n✅ Finished! Final plots saved to: ", OUT_DIR)


```
```{r}
# =========================================================
# FINAL SECTION — ADD TIME-NORMALIZED DENSITY (7.5 min interval)
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

WORK_DIR <- "C:/Users/Supriya Monajigari/Documents"
OUT_DIR  <- file.path(WORK_DIR, "gps_density_final_plots")
if (!dir.exists(OUT_DIR)) dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)

# 🔹 Set your GPS fix interval (minutes between points)
FIX_INTERVAL_MIN <- 7.5  # each GPS fix = 7.5 minutes apart

# 🟢 Combine all extracted density tables
all_dens <- bind_rows(dens_true, dens_plus, dens_minus)

# 🟢 Detect treatment based on last letter before .gpkg (or _true, etc.)
all_dens <- all_dens %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = case_when(
      grepl("D(_|\\.|$)", toupper(Plot)) ~ "Deferred",
      grepl("C(_|\\.|$)", toupper(Plot)) ~ "Continuous",
      grepl("E(_|\\.|$)", toupper(Plot)) ~ "Exclosed",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ),
    Phase = case_when(
      grepl("1", Phase) ~ "Phase1",
      grepl("2", Phase) ~ "Phase2",
      TRUE ~ Phase
    ),
    # 🔹 Calculate time spent (hours) and normalized density
    Time_hours = (Points * FIX_INTERVAL_MIN) / 60,
    Density_pts_ha_hr = Points / (Area_ha * Time_hours)
  )

# 🧭 Verify detection
print(table(all_dens$Treatment))

# 🟢 Summarize mean ± SE for both density metrics
summary_density <- all_dens %>%
  filter(Treatment %in% c("Deferred", "Continuous", "Exclosed")) %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Variant, Phase) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_density = mean(Density_pts_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_density   = sd(Density_pts_ha, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    mean_density_time = mean(Density_pts_ha_hr, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_density_time   = sd(Density_pts_ha_hr, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 🟢 Fill missing combinations so all treatments appear
summary_density <- expand_grid(
  Treatment = c("Deferred", "Continuous", "Exclosed"),
  Variant   = unique(summary_density$Variant),
  Phase     = unique(summary_density$Phase)
) %>%
  left_join(summary_density, by = c("Treatment", "Variant", "Phase")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(mean_density, se_density, mean_density_time, se_density_time),
                ~replace_na(.x, 0)))

# 🟢 Consistent ordering for nicer plots
summary_density$Treatment <- factor(summary_density$Treatment,
  levels = c("Deferred", "Continuous", "Exclosed"))
summary_density$Variant <- factor(summary_density$Variant,
  levels = c("True", "Liberal (+5 m)", "Conservative (−5 m)"))

# 🟢 Plot function generator
make_plot <- function(df, phase_label, title_text, y_var, y_se, y_label, file_suffix) {
  gg <- ggplot(filter(df, Phase == phase_label),
               aes(x = Treatment, y = !!sym(y_var), fill = Variant)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = !!sym(y_var) - !!sym(y_se),
                      ymax = !!sym(y_var) + !!sym(y_se)),
                  width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
    labs(title = title_text, x = "Treatment Type", y = y_label) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "True" = "#1b9e77",
      "Liberal (+5 m)" = "#d95f02",
      "Conservative (−5 m)" = "#7570b3"
    )) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "top")
  
  ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(phase_label, "_", file_suffix, ".png")),
         gg, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
}

# 🟢 Create and save per-phase plots
for (phase in unique(summary_density$Phase)) {
  # (1) Spatial-only density
  make_plot(summary_density, phase,
            paste("Mean GPS Point Density (", ifelse(phase=="Phase1", "Jul 1 – Aug 3", "Aug 4 – Sep 3"), ")", sep=""),
            "mean_density", "se_density",
            "Mean GPS Point Density (points / ha)",
            "density")
  
  # (2) Time-normalized density
  make_plot(summary_density, phase,
            paste("Time-normalized GPS Density (", ifelse(phase=="Phase1", "Jul 1 – Aug 3", "Aug 4 – Sep 3"), ")", sep=""),
            "mean_density_time", "se_density_time",
            "Mean GPS Point Density (points / ha / hr)",
            "density_time")
}

# 🟢 Optional combined plot (faceted by Phase for comparison)
facet_plot <- ggplot(summary_density,
  aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_density_time, fill = Variant)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_density_time - se_density_time,
                    ymax = mean_density_time + se_density_time),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  facet_wrap(~Phase) +
  labs(title = "Time-Normalized GPS Point Density Across Phases",
       x = "Treatment Type",
       y = "Mean GPS Point Density (points / ha / hr)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "True" = "#1b9e77",
    "Liberal (+5 m)" = "#d95f02",
    "Conservative (−5 m)" = "#7570b3"
  )) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top")

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "facet_time_density_comparison.png"),
       facet_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

message("\n✅ All four primary plots + 1 facet comparison saved in: ", OUT_DIR)

```
